title: Review unjustified refusals and blocks in TermAl's workflow (Greg + Kimi): keep only the necessary ones, each with a stated cause and fix
outcome: Every refusal or block in TermAl's workflow is listed. For each, the concrete problem it solves is named and a verdict is given: necessary, or remove. Unjustified restrictions and false refusals get an owner and a simple fix. Every refusal that stays tells the user its cause and a possible correction. No new gates are added, and Comovo sync delivery is not delayed.
acceptance: An inventory of TermAl refusals and blocks, with file:line for each, read-only and led by Kimi::Consultant. It covers check recognition and test credit, launcher input and registration refusals, acceptance evaluation and done blockers, delegation and mailbox refusals, named-root and source-root refusals, and Codex approval and command refusals. Each entry states the concrete problem the refusal solves and a verdict: necessary, or remove/relax.

Every remove/relax verdict is filed as its own owned item with a simple fix. Every refusal kept as necessary either already states its cause and a possible correction in its message, or has an owned item that adds them.
No new review, evaluation, FULL or approval gate is introduced, and no Comovo sync work is delayed. A short Polish report reaches Greg via Engram::Asistant.
